snippet.title: Find 100 Ducks And Blast Them! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Yes! In this FREE game you must blast 100 toy ducks! Relax, take aim, and let the feathers fly! With light-hearted gameplay and cute ducks to hunt, it's a casual first-person experience full of wholesome, family-friendly fun!

Wishlist on Steam!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3222970/Find_100_Ducks_and_Blast_Them/?utm_source=YOUTUBE
